semantic_findings.finding: s3ShiftHead is a logical right shift, not a byte rotation
evidence: LoadUnitDataPath.sv: s3ShiftHead = {_s3ShiftHead_T[127:120], _GEN[119:112], ...} where _GEN = s3Data[127:8] for offset 1
the only high-byte fill is the offset=15 term, which places s3Data[127:120] in result[7:0]
a rotation would have produced result[127:120] = s3Data[7:0]; the RTL leaves it 0
semantic_findings.impact: the initial model rotated and produced wrong bytes at offset>=1; the corrected model matches all 16 offsets
